_README.what: Props are in-world documents you can open. An item record says a ledger exists; a prop lets the reader read it. Rendered by renderProp() in index.html, styled by app/styles/systems/exhibits.css.
where_they_appear: Inline in any prose field, via the marker [[prop:<id>|visible text]] — becomes a clickable .proplink.
As a tile grid on the item page of every item listed in the prop's `items` array.
As an 'Exhibits' card at the foot of any article listed in the prop's `articles` array.
_README.adding_one: Add an object here, give it `kind`, `title`, `body` (HTML using the .pd-* classes) and at least one link in `items` or `articles`. No JS or CSS changes are needed. Keep the body factual to the source record — a prop is evidence, not new canon.
_README.stamps: Optional. `stamps: ["overdue"]` renders .pd-stamp--overdue. Available: overdue, paid, void, sealed, noaction, evidence.

prop_ebot_correction_demand.title: Correction Demand — Sheet 41
prop_ebot_correction_demand.subtitle: Filed 1032 BF · acknowledged by a clerk · never answered
prop_ebot_correction_demand.note: The demand was posted, acknowledged, and never acted upon. The Company later burned down with its plates inside, which is why Survey Series IV can no longer be corrected by anybody at any price.
prop_ebot_correction_demand.body:
Walupedia Editorial Board
Office of the Auditor-General
To
The Works Manager, The Old World Mapping Company
Re
Survey Series IV, Sheet 41 — defective plate
Dated
19 Aethel, 1032 BF

Sir,

Your Sheet 41 names the mountain at the head of the Northern Reach MOUNT EBOT. The mountain is correctly Mount Ebot. The mountain your customers believe they are buying is Mount Ebott, which lies four hundred miles east of it, and which contains a barrier, a quantity of monsters, and a king with a beard.

Your cartouche offers corrections on application. This is the application.

On the seventeenth of this month a party of three reached the summit of your Sheet 41 on the strength of your spelling. A chartered aircraft was destroyed. A twenty-two-year-old man was opened above the eye by a thrown bone and dressed under an overhang in hail. He was promised nothing and has so far received it.

Waluigi does not ask for damages. Waluigi asks for a T.

Correct the plate. Reissue the sheet. Every copy still folded in a saddlebag is a hazard you engraved.

Waluigi
Auditor-General
 
For the Company — no reply received
Acknowledged by a clerk, 24 Aethel 1032. Nothing further. Works destroyed by fire; plates lost. — filed to archive 1040 BF

If this reaches the right hands it will mean nothing to the wrong ones, and that is the whole of my hope.

Ask for the place where roses grow in winter. Do not ask a lord. Ask someone who carries things and is not looked at.

The one who greets you there will not use my name. If they say the roses were planted for a wedding that did not happen, that is the sign, and you may say anything after it.

I am well. That is also a code, and I am sorry for it.

🌹
Unsigned — a drawn rose in place of a name

ENTRANCE. Not through the door. Through the door is what they are watching.

LIGHT. Behind. Always behind. A face explained is a face diminished.

THE LINE. Delivered once. If it must be repeated the scene has already failed and the failure is theirs.

prop_toad_lee_diary_page.body:
Diary of Lady Aurelian · loose page, preserved

They call it grafting, which is a gardener's word, and they chose it on purpose. A graft takes. A graft is not a wound, it is a joining, and the tree does not complain afterwards because the tree has nothing left to complain with.

What is joined is not the flesh. Anyone can join flesh. What is joined is the line — and a line that has been joined once can be joined again, which is the part they do not say aloud at the table.

The Legion watches the wrong end of it. They watch the bodies. The bodies are the least interesting part. Watch the blood-work, and watch who is keeping the record of it, because whoever keeps that record decides afterwards what happened.

A.
Unsigned beyond the initial

prop_tea_syndicate_page.title: The Third Steeping — House Doctrine
prop_tea_syndicate_page.subtitle: A page from the Tea Leaf Syndicate book · read by Eager, absorbed by nobody
prop_tea_syndicate_page.note: Tea people made hot leaf water into doctrine. Waluigi is annoyed and impressed, in that order, and only just.
prop_tea_syndicate_page.body:
The Tea Leaf Syndicate
On the Third Steeping · House Doctrine, Article the Ninth
i. The first steeping is for the guest. It is courteous, it is weak, and it tells you nothing.
ii. The second steeping is for the table. By it a house is judged, and by it a house intends to be judged, which is why the second steeping is never the truth.
iii. The third steeping is for the business. It is taken after the guest has said the thing they came to say and before they have decided whether they meant it.
iv. A leaf held too long turns bitter and cannot be made sweet again by any subsequent kindness. The Syndicate applies this to leaves and to people and considers the comparison exact.
v. Serve the third steeping yourself. A cup poured by a servant is a cup poured by whoever pays the servant.
Preparations not found in polite markets are treated in Articles the Eleventh through Fourteenth, which are not reproduced here and which the archive has not seen.
Clause v is genuine operational security dressed as etiquette. Eager read this page and learned nothing, which is also data. — W.

The Mages Guild
Office of Restricted Foci · correspondence

To the King of the Koopas, wherever this finds him,

It has come to the Guild’s attention that an object dropped by the claimant Vivian during the corridor engagement at the Shadow Estate — a focus of death aspect, cold to the touch, of a make the Guild recognises and does not admire — was subsequently retrieved from the floor by yourself.

The Guild does not suggest that you took it improperly. The Guild observes only that it was on the floor and you are, by all accounts, a person who picks things up.

Awaiting your reply, without confidence,

Keeper of Restricted Foci
The Mages Guild

The neighbor left in a hurry, right? Like someone called him. And when I was leaving the basement, I saw his desk upstairs — the one near the front door. There was a communicator on it. Still active. Still connected. And there was a voice coming through it. Faint. But I heard it.

Walupedia Editorial Board
Classification ruling · main chronicle vs. footnote
Attached after filing — the placement was challenged and the challenge failed

A lesser historian would place this in a footnote and call it psychological color. Waluigi is not a lesser historian.

Objects appearing in the dream that are live files elsewhere in this archive:

ObjectAlso filed under
Star ShardsArtifacts — active recovery
Star CoreArtifacts — hesitation on record
Frog GodDivine consequence — the abandoned Toad
EagerHostage leverage — ongoing
HjumpikTrust imagery
Original DanPersonal consequence — entanglement
The VigilanceAirship — burning, in the dream

If a dream contains that many active files, it is no longer color. It is a filing cabinet on fire.

The dream also connects two kinds of consequence. The Frog God is the cosmic result of Archie abandoning the Toad. Original Dan is the personal result of Archie being tangled in another person's destruction. The dream forces Archie to face both, then wakes him where the current party crisis continues. That is structure. Cruel structure, but structure.

Standing recommendation
1. Archie should tell someone immediately — not later, not after three jokes and one accidental tactical disaster.
2. Told, the dream becomes shared preparation.
3. Kept private, it remains the Frog God's rehearsal room inside his skull — and privacy lets shame edit the useful parts.
Waluigi prefers enemy rehearsals to be interrupted.

Money is not the only thing characters carry. They carry obligations. They carry evidence. They carry debts that never entered a ledger because the person who issued them smiled instead of writing them down.

Waluigi will track both, because Waluigi knows that unrecorded debts are how people end up dancing forever.

II. The charge is laid under the standing instruments and requires no complainant.
III. Non-attendance is itself an answer, and will be recorded as one.
IV. Service is effected on delivery. The bearer does not wait for a reply and is not empowered to receive one.
For the Bench
Justicar presiding — name struck from the served copy
Note the fourth clause. The Bench has arranged to be unreachable at the exact moment it becomes reasonable to negotiate. That is not an oversight in the drafting; that is the drafting. — W.

prop_archmage_requisition.subtitle: The Guild billed for the elixir and separately for the indignity

prop_dragon_barter_note.title: Barter Note — Mushrooms, Sundry, Against One Scale
prop_dragon_barter_note.subtitle: Written on the reverse of a ration chit by a party who could not read the front
prop_dragon_barter_note.note: The dragon believed it had the better of this. Waluigi is not certain the dragon was wrong.

Reverse of a ration chit

Both parties

Note on the spotted variety. The spotted kind is a controlled reagent below the capital. Six bags of it moved across a table, unremarked, as the worthless half of a trade.
Two parties each walked away certain they had cheated the other, and the archive’s view is that they were both right, which is the only kind of trade Waluigi genuinely enjoys reading about. — W.

prop_ashford_transcript.title: Testimony — The Ashford Spirit, As Relayed
prop_ashford_transcript.subtitle: Transcribed at one remove. The archive says so at the top rather than the bottom.
prop_ashford_transcript.note: The only testimony this file has, and it arrives through a hand the archive cannot identify.
prop_ashford_transcript.body:
Relayed testimony · second-hand by admission
Notes in a hand resembling Luigi’s. Not authenticated.
“The coronations were theatre. Real power signed in blood not ink. What was signed is sealed in iron, beneath the hanging tree, in the Thornwood.”
Speaker
Ashford, deceased, manifesting
Relay
Notes taken by a third party at the time; hand not authenticated
Corroboration
None. No second hearer has been produced.
On the phrase signed in blood not ink. Capable of two readings. Figurative: a settlement enforced by violence. Literal: an instrument executed in blood, which is a documentary form with a shelf life and a smell, and which iron would be a sensible container for.
On the phrase theatre. Capable of only one reading, and it is the useful one. Theatre has a budget.
Filed under protest. Waluigi objects to the whole class of evidence and has filed it anyway, because refusing to file the only testimony you have is not scepticism, it is squeamishness.

prop_satyr_songsheet.title: Song Sheet — Two Verses, One Written Over the Other
prop_satyr_songsheet.subtitle: A performer's working copy, with the correction still legible underneath
prop_satyr_songsheet.note: The verse the satyr sang and the verse the satyr crossed out are both on this sheet, and only one of them was safe.
prop_satyr_songsheet.body:
Performer’s working sheet
Recovered from the pit. Two hands, or one hand twice.
“Oh the Legion marches iron-shod,
and the Legion answers to the rod,
and the rod is held by a living god
and the rod is held by the ones abroad.”
Struck line. Legible beneath the correction. Written in the same ink and the same hand as the rest of the verse.
Replacement line. Written in a harder pressure and slightly cramped, as though fitted into a space that was already the wrong size.
Performed. The replacement. Witnesses agree the Legion danced.
A satyr sang a room full of soldiers into a dance, and the only edit on the sheet is the line that would have told them who holds the rod. He changed it before he walked in, not during. That is not stage fright, that is a risk assessment. — W.

prop_goblin_parole.title: Parole Note — One Guard, Spared, Released on Terms
prop_goblin_parole.subtitle: Written by the man who was spared, at the request of the people who spared him
prop_goblin_parole.note: The party let a guard live and got a document out of it, which is a better return than most mercy earns.
prop_goblin_parole.body:
Undertaking, given freely
Hand: the maker’s own, unsteady, in charcoal

“I was on the door. They did not kill me. I said I would write what I know and I am writing it.

The orders for the hall came down two days before, not that night. We were told there would be a performance and we were told not to interfere with it. I do not know who told the captain. The captain was pleased about it.

I go north now. I will not be at that door again.”

The duty return of the same evening
Two days before. That is the whole exhibit. The Legion did not spontaneously dance to a satyr — the Legion had been told, in advance, to permit a performance it had no reason to expect. — W.

prop_speaker_l_decoy_brief.title: Decoy Brief — What the Green Speaker Was to Say, and When to Stop
prop_speaker_l_decoy_brief.subtitle: A written plan for being the wrong person in the right room
prop_speaker_l_decoy_brief.note: The brief survives. Whether it was followed is a separate exhibit.
prop_speaker_l_decoy_brief.body:
Brief · for the speaker attending
Read, memorised, and not to be carried into the chamber
1. You are the delegation. There is no other delegation. If asked whether others are coming, say they are not.
2. Speak to the resettlement question at length. Detail is the point. The longer the chamber discusses where, the longer it is not discussing who.
3. If the words order and one hundred and twenty are used together, stop speaking, sit down, and do not answer further questions.
4. Do not defend anyone by name. A name in the record is a name on a list.
5. You will be believed because you are expected. That is the entire mechanism. Do not improve on it.
Clause 3 means somebody already knew the number before the chamber sat. A decoy brief that names the trigger phrase in advance is not a decoy brief, it is a warning that was written down. — W.

Recitals and schedules omitted
Clause 2. No body other than the Legion shall maintain armed men within a ward of the city.

prop_avatar_terms_memo.title: Terms Memorandum — What Was Asked For, in Four Lines
prop_avatar_terms_memo.subtitle: Somebody in that circle wrote the terms down while they were still being spoken
prop_avatar_terms_memo.note: Every negotiation has one participant taking notes. This is theirs.
prop_avatar_terms_memo.body:
Memorandum · taken at the circle
Contemporaneous. Not agreed by any party.
Asked of us. That armed men of the Loyalist establishment be quartered within the district, permanently, and at the district’s request.
Offered to us. Recognition. Standing. The rite completed rather than abandoned.
Objected by one voice. “A garrison you asked for is still a garrison.”
Answered. “A garrison you asked for is a garrison you can un-ask.”
Not addressed. Whether the un-asking has any legal effect. Nobody in the circle raised the Mandate.
The objection and the answer are both good and only one of them is true. Waluigi has read clause 9 of the Mandate and can report that the un-asking is worth precisely nothing, and that nobody at the circle knew it. — W.

prop_sovereignty_act_notice.subtitle: The offence is not the pact, it is who the pact was with
prop_sovereignty_act_notice.note: The Act was posted three streets from the festival ground. Somebody wanted it read that week.
prop_sovereignty_act_notice.body:
By authority · posted notice
Supernatural Sovereignty Act · summary for posting
The full text is available for inspection at the ward office
1. No allegiance, undertaking or covenant may be given to any power not of the mortal establishment.
2. An undertaking given in the course of a rite is an undertaking for the purposes of clause 1.
3. The offence is complete on the giving. Performance is not required.
4. The offence is triable as sedition.
5. Where the undertaking is given collectively, every person present who did not dissent aloud is taken to have given it.
Posted this quarter. Ward office copy stamped and dated.
Clause 5 is the one that should frighten people and clause 3 is the one that should frighten lawyers. Everybody who stood in that circle and did not shout is, on the face of this notice, a seditionist. — W.

prop_tl_interrogation.title: Interrogation Record — The Green Prisoner
prop_tl_interrogation.subtitle: Four words, one poisoned mushroom, and nothing else for the file
prop_tl_interrogation.note: The interrogator wrote down doctrine and filed it as rhetoric. It was a delaying tactic.
prop_tl_interrogation.body:
Aegis Command · Records section · Interview note
Subject: prisoner presenting as Speaker L
Interviewing officer notes taken contemporaneously.
On appearance. Subject's colouring is markedly green. Asked to account for it. States he ate a poisoned mushroom and the colour changed.
On organisation. Subject recites: CONTAIN. ACCOUNT. RESTORE. ADHERE. Repeats on request. Adds nothing.
This is not retribution's art, but the mending of the fractured heart.
On dispositions. Nil. Subject provides no names, no strengths, no locations.
Assessment. Cult-like rhetoric. Subject assessed as low intelligence value. Interview suspended.
A man in a cell explained restorative justice to the people torturing him and they wrote 'cult-like rhetoric' in the assessment box. He was not the Speaker and he was not raving. He was running out the clock, in verse, and it worked. — W.

Issued under the authority of the officer commanding.

prop_charred_note_secret_history_mario.title: Charred Note — SECRET HISTORY MARIO

prop_charred_note_secret_history_mario.note: The fire spared exactly the sentences a writer would most want read.
prop_charred_note_secret_history_mario.body:
Recovered at the threshold of Tymnas's cottage
Unsigned · smoke-scented · edges charred inward from three sides
SECRET HISTORY MARIO
Filed by Waluigi the same morning it appeared. No seal. No courier. No helpful explanation. The center survived better than the margins because somebody planned it that way.
Opening posture. The writer stages Mario as openly hostile, suspicious of Bowser, suspicious of Luigi, and perfectly willing to threaten a stranger for speaking too slowly.
Claim one. When the questioner says Peach is dead and asks whether grief drove him east, Mario replies: “I didn't leave because of grief. I left because I killed her.”
Claim two. The note produces a gold locket with Peach and Mario pictured together and insists a wedding certificate existed with Bowser as witness. The scene is written for maximum outrage and should be read with that in mind.
Claim three. Mario confirms the farm story only to break it: he says he stayed not for months or years but for three days, died there, and later answers the question of what happened next with “I woke up.”
Claim four. Asked about the Mages' Guild, Mario says yes. An arrest is attempted under Section 1.6 with a null cage. The note then describes three consecutive cage failures and Mario laughing at the third.
Claim five. When pressed about the Star Fountain meeting with Luigi, Mario answers at the end with a silent nod rather than a denial.
A forged confession is still evidence of what somebody wants the archive to stare at. Peach. The farm. The Guild. The fountain. All on one page, as if Waluigi did not already have enough enemies. — W.
The intervening stage directions are extravagant, ash-heavy, and emotionally manipulative. Waluigi files the claims, not the performance. The performance is obvious.

Question one. Are you real?
Reply. Gunshot through the newly repaired pane. Verbal supplement: Would a fake do that?
